profile_text.body:
Netflix describes itself as one of the world's leading entertainment services, offering TV series, films, games and live programming across a wide variety of genres and languages. According to its site, members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time. The company says it has over 260 million paid memberships in over 190 countries.

Netflix is a public company traded under the ticker NFLX, headquartered in Los Gatos, California, with SEC CIK 0001065280. The material published on its own site describes entertainment offerings rather than AI products or services, and no AI products or MCP servers are listed for it.

Its litigation exposure is recorded in California, with 281 cases counted there. No individual lawsuits are named in the available material.
